name: Goukan Kyakusen ~Jigoku no Cruise~
original_name: 強奸客船～地獄のクルーズ～
source:
A luxury cruise ship "Tsukimiya" gets captured by terrorists. They ask main character to become a collaborator. He agrees in order to realize his feelings towards the girl he likes. No female passenger is going to be spared.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
豪华游轮“月宫”号被恐怖分子劫持。他们要求主角成为合作者。他为了实现对自己喜欢的女孩的感情而同意了。没有一位女性乘客能够幸免。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
